vaizey.l: Incontinence for solid stool (0 never to 4 daily)
Incontinence for liquid stool (0 never to 4 daily)
Incontinence for gas (0 never to 4 daily)
Alteration in lifestyle (0 never to 4 daily)

van-nuys-vnpi.l: Pathologic classification: 1 = non-high grade no necrosis, 2 = non-high grade with necrosis, 3 = high grade

vanc-auc.l: Peak draw time after infusion end

Head and neck: residual depigmentation. vasopressor.l: Dose to convert to a rate (in the drug units: mcg/min, mcg/kg/min, or units/min)
OR a pump rate (mL/hr) to convert back to a dose

vent-sbt-peep.l: Vasopressors at more than minimal dose

vereckei-avr.l: Step 1: initial dominant R wave in aVR
Step 2: initial r or q wave > 40 ms in aVR
Step 3: notch on the descending limb of a negative-onset QRS

ves-13.l: Needs help walking across the room

vesikari.l: Duration of diarrhea [0 - none; 1 - 1 to 4 days; 2 - 5 days; 3 - 6 days or more]
Maximum diarrheal stools in 24 hours [0 - none; 1 - 1 to 3; 2 - 4 to 5; 3 - 6 or more]
Duration of vomiting [0 - none; 1 - 1 day; 2 - 2 days; 3 - 3 days or more]
Maximum vomiting episodes in 24 hours [0 - none; 1 - 1; 2 - 2 to 4; 3 - 5 or more]
Maximum temperature, as a rectal-equivalent reading [0 - below 37.1 C; 1 - 37.1 to 38.4 C; 2 - 38.5 to 38.9 C; 3 - 39.0 C or above]
Dehydration, as percentage of body weight lost [0 - none; 2 - 1 to 5 percent; 3 - 6 percent or more]
Treatment (one item, not two) [0 - none; 1 - rehydration; 2 - hospitalization]

vhi10.l: 2. Being understood in a noisy room

vhwg-hernia.l: Previous wound infection, a stoma, or GI-tract violation (Grade 3)
Smoking, obesity, diabetes, immunosuppression, or COPD (Grade 2)

vras.l: AVM volume. Banded, not continuous: Less than 2 cm^3 = 0; 2 to 4 cm^3 = 1; More than 4 cm^3 = 2. IT SATURATES above 4 cm^3.
Eloquent location. 1 point - half the weight volume can carry.
Prior hemorrhage. 1 point. The companion score does not use this variable at all.
